formattedAddress: No. 7號, Lane 48, Taiyuan Rd, Jianming Village, Datong District, Taipei City, Taiwan 103

displayName.text: 富春食堂 無菜單料理

text.text:
Absolutely the best sashimi I have ever had (believe it or not, including Japan!). The freshness and flavours of each individual slice shines through. Really well priced, much better than what you'd get in the restaurants. If you're lucky, you'll find the chef playing the piano whilst you're eating.

Can be a bit tricky to find the restaurant as its down a quiet lane.

text.text: The kind of place that brings a tear to your eye - best chirashi-don I’ve ever had in my life. The sushi rice, the way the sashimi is sliced, the aburi, the perilla leaves - everything is unpretentious and prepared to the highest standards. I don’t think you’ll be able to get it such standards even in Japan. I had the 富春 deluxe / signature chirashi-don and it feels like an omakase in a bowl. Whenever I visit Taipei, I’ll come to this restaurant at least 4 times on a 7-day trip, and I’m not even exaggerating 😆 The chef owner is so modest about his top-notch culinary skills. So glad to have found an absolute gem in Taipei in this family-run restaurant. 真的太谢谢你了，老板老板娘！下次再见哦！🙏💯😋
